text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having some business to attend to,
I stopped by Neo Universe's classroom, and...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, perfect timing!
You're Universe's Trainer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Help me out here!
Warm this guy up!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was startled by Neo Universe's bizarre state.
Even though we were indoors, she was wearing an overcoat,
sipping miso soup, with a foot warmer at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's cold, so I'm warming it up!
You come up with an idea too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! From what I hear, even after exercising,
her body temperature barely rises at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Changes in Umamusume body temperature and their effects on athletic performance! This is the perfect guine—I mean, opportunity to test cooldown efficiency!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Rather, because they are our precious classmates! Shakur-kun and I were merely discussing our policy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First, we should identify the cause of the chill.
Hey, let me measure your baseline data.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
I will accept any "LiDAR."
choice_data_list: (She seems into it, so maybe I'll just watch over her)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, how are the results after taking measures against the cold from both inside and out, Universe-kun?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "magnitude" remains unchanged...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In short, almost no change at all, huh?
Hmm, it looks like simply warming it up won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Even so, continuously targeting the internal organs is faster and more reliable, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
True... Let's focus on blood circulation next.
How about trying an ab stimulation belt?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You're puttin' on an ab toning belt?! Hilarious!
How 'bout we do a miso soup challenge with that on, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, *sluuuuurp*...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, starting to warm up a bit, aren't we!?
Let's crank the vibration level up another notch!
choice_data_list: No, any more than this would really be...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...That's right, Pokke-san, Tachyon-san. Let's not take this any further..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Universe-san, too... there's no need
to force yourself to go along with silly pranks...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How rude! This isn't a prank, it's an act of charity!
Now then, what approach should I try next?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just trying everything at random ain't gonna cut it.
Think about efficiency. Keep your approach precise—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While her classmates actively debate this and that,
Neo Universe silently sips her miso soup...
choice_data_list: That turned into quite the experiment.
That turned into quite the experiment.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The ecology of an alien is "Gliese"...
Because Neo Universe is "rare," you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ecology of an alien is rare and unusual... Is it really?
To my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Universe-kun!
How is that ab toning belt treating you? Give me a progress—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Your hands and feet are still cold, dear.
Are you usually this cold?
Let's try turning up the classroom heater a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if the AC ain't right, just say so.
Freezing your ass off is completely inefficient.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! Do try this drink!
It's an amazake base with citric acid, tuna extract,
and a byproduct from an experiment I stumbled upon the other day—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please wait, about those ingredients just now...
There are some distinctly concerning elements in there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It really does seem like they're worried
and caring about Neo Universe's sensitivity to the cold. But—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gah, what the heck, that looks disgusting! Seriously, don't eat that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""OPON".
Unraveling mysteries... "abundant" data is best."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Neo Universe still believed she was
merely treated as a novelty.
It was somewhat frustrating, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—That is precisely why it's worth trying!
Hey, don't you think so too?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm telling you my special drink is worth drinking.
Yet Cafe goes on about some gentle dietary therapy
or whatever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They seem to be arguing over whether a special drink or dietary therapy is the better choice...
choice_data_list: Let's use a drink to get immediate results
I want to learn more about dietary therapy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, so you understand!
Don't worry, it only contains edible nutrients.
Down it in one gulp, come on!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “UNDY”――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...There is no "fluctuation" in the values.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ehh! You're really tough to beat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The boisterous experiments continued after that—
Neo Universe seems to lead a surprisingly lively
and caring daily life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's bound to take some time,
but it feels like something we can put into practice daily with greater certainty.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How dull.
A spirit of adventure is essential at times, my friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please do not throw a tantrum...
This is the natural decision.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's have hot pot for lunch today!
There was something super tasty-looking on the cafe menu, right?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Lunch, hot pot"... so basically, "sharing"?
—A Sfera, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe shared lunch with everyone.
Though she doesn't seem fully aware of it yet,
the day she connects with those around her might be surprisingly close."
